## Configuration in MegaLinter

- Enable jupyfmt by adding `JUPYTER_JUPYFMT` in [ENABLE_LINTERS variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#activation-and-deactivation)
- Disable jupyfmt by adding `JUPYTER_JUPYFMT` in [DISABLE_LINTERS variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#activation-and-deactivation)

- Enable **autofixes** by adding `JUPYTER_JUPYFMT` in [APPLY_FIXES variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#apply-fixes)

| Variable                                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Default value      |
|---------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------|
| JUPYTER_JUPYFMT_ARGUMENTS                   | User custom arguments to add in linter CLI call<br/>Ex: `-s --foo "bar"`                                                                                                                                            |                    |
| JUPYTER_JUPYFMT_COMMAND_REMOVE_ARGUMENTS    | User custom arguments to remove from command line before calling the linter<br/>Ex: `-s --foo "bar"`                                                                                                                |                    |
| JUPYTER_JUPYFMT_FILTER_REGEX_INCLUDE        | Custom regex including filter<br/>Ex: `(src\|lib)`                                                                                                                                                                  | Exclude no file    |
| JUPYTER_JUPYFMT_FILTER_REGEX_EXCLUDE        | Custom regex excluding filter<br/>Ex: `(test\|examples)`                                                                                                                                                            | Exclude no file    |
| JUPYTER_JUPYFMT_CLI_LINT_MODE               | Override default CLI lint mode<br/>- `file`: Calls the linter for each file                                                                                                                                         | `file`             |
| JUPYTER_JUPYFMT_FILE_EXTENSIONS             | Allowed file extensions. `"*"` matches any extension, `""` matches empty extension. Empty list excludes all files<br/>Ex: `[".py", ""]`                                                                             | `[".ipynb"]`       |
| JUPYTER_JUPYFMT_FILE_NAMES_REGEX            | File name regex filters. Regular expression list for filtering files by their base names using regex full match. Empty list includes all files<br/>Ex: `["Dockerfile(-.+)?", "Jenkinsfile"]`                        | Include every file |
| JUPYTER_JUPYFMT_PRE_COMMANDS                | List of bash commands to run before the linter                                                                                                                                                                      | None               |
| JUPYTER_JUPYFMT_POST_COMMANDS               | List of bash commands to run after the linter                                                                                                                                                                       | None               |
| JUPYTER_JUPYFMT_UNSECURED_ENV_VARIABLES     | List of env variables explicitly not filtered before calling JUPYTER_JUPYFMT and its pre/post commands                                                                                                              | None               |
| JUPYTER_JUPYFMT_DISABLE_ERRORS              | Run linter but consider errors as warnings                                                                                                                                                                          | `true`             |
| JUPYTER_JUPYFMT_DISABLE_ERRORS_IF_LESS_THAN | Maximum number of errors allowed                                                                                                                                                                                    | `0`                |
| JUPYTER_JUPYFMT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS             | Maximum duration in seconds of the linter run, after which the linter process and its child processes are killed and reported as an error (exit code 124). Overrides LINTER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS. 0 disables the timeout | `300`              |
| JUPYTER_JUPYFMT_CLI_EXECUTABLE              | Override CLI executable                                                                                                                                                                                             | `['jupyfmt']`      |

## Use this plugin

Add the descriptor URL of the plugin to `PLUGINS` in `.mega-linter.yml`. MegaLinter installs the plugin when it starts, whatever the flavor:

```yaml
PLUGINS:
  - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kpj/jupyfmt/master/mega-linter-plugin-jupyfmt/jupyfmt.megalinter-descriptor.yml
```

## Behind the scenes

### How are identified applicable files

- File extensions: `.ipynb`

<!-- markdownlint-disable -->
<!-- /* cSpell:disable */ -->
### How the linting is performed

- jupyfmt is called one time by identified file (`file` CLI lint mode)

### Example calls

```shell
jupyfmt --check --compact-diff Notebook.ipynb
```


### Installation in Docker

MegaLinter runs these commands when it loads the plugin (only `RUN` instructions):

```dockerfile
RUN pip install jupyfmt
```

### Installation without Docker (native mode)

> **Native mode does not run plugins yet**: this section shows what the plugin declares for native mode.

Not available: see the MegaLinter checks of the plugin.

## MegaLinter checks

These results last changed on 2026-11-28, and MegaLinter checks the plugins every day. The checks only look at the descriptor of the plugin: they do not review the plugin, nor the tool it runs.

| Check        | Result                                  |
|:-------------|:----------------------------------------|
| Descriptor   | ⚠️ Incomplete                           |
| Native mode  | ❌ Not supported                        |
| SARIF output | ❌                                      |
| Native lock  | ⚠️ No lock shipped by the plugin author |

### Required

Missing required items:

- **`native_install` declared and valid for the 5 native platforms** (`JUPYTER_JUPYFMT`): Native mode (MegaLinter without Docker) can not install the linter. Declare `native_install`, listing each of linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64 in `platforms` or in `unsupported` (with a reason)
- **SARIF output** (`JUPYTER_JUPYFMT`): The findings are missing from SARIF reports (GitHub code scanning, SARIF viewers, coding agents). Set `can_output_sarif: true` with `cli_sarif_args` when the tool outputs SARIF, otherwise `sarif_text_regex` (one finding per line of text) or `sarif_unified_diff: true` (formatters printing a diff)
- **`cli_lint_mode`** (`JUPYTER_JUPYFMT`): MegaLinter calls the tool once per file, which may not be how it works. Set `cli_lint_mode` to `file`, `list_of_files` or `project`

### Recommended

Missing recommended items:

- **Native lock shipped next to the descriptor (`<name>.megalinter-native-lock.json`), for verified native installs**
- **Rules documentation URL (`linter_rules_url`)** (`JUPYTER_JUPYFMT`)
- **Configuration documentation URL (`linter_rules_configuration_url`)** (`JUPYTER_JUPYFMT`)
- **Inline disable documentation URL (`linter_rules_inline_disable_url`)** (`JUPYTER_JUPYFMT`)
- **Ignore file documentation URL (`linter_rules_ignore_config_url`)** (`JUPYTER_JUPYFMT`)
- **SPDX license (`linter_spdx_license`)** (`JUPYTER_JUPYFMT`)
- **Speed (`linter_speed`, 1 to 5)** (`JUPYTER_JUPYFMT`)
- **Icon (`linter_icon_png_url`)** (`JUPYTER_JUPYFMT`)
- **IDE extensions (`ide`)** (`JUPYTER_JUPYFMT`)
- **Supported lint modes (`supported_cli_lint_modes`)** (`JUPYTER_JUPYFMT`)
- **Error counting (`cli_lint_errors_count` and `cli_lint_errors_regex`)** (`JUPYTER_JUPYFMT`)
- **Default configuration file (`config_file_name`)** (`JUPYTER_JUPYFMT`)
- **Test fixtures (`test_folder`)** (`JUPYTER_JUPYFMT`)
